page.overview:
What is Shigeru?

Shigeru (written: 茂, 繁, 滋, しげる in hiragana or シゲル in katakana) is a masculine Japanese given name. Notable people with the name include:

Shigeru Aburaya (油谷 繁; born 1977), Japanese long-distance runner

Shigeru Akabane (赤羽 茂; 1941–2011), Japanese professional midget wrestler

Shigeru Amachi (天知 茂; 1931–1985), Japanese actor
